body:
Found while fixing the same defect in the cover-enforcer copy on #1410.

`cps/cwa_functions.py` defines three `download_current_log()` handlers, one per
log-owning blueprint (epub-fixer, convert-library, cover-enforcer). Each does:

    try:
        ...
        if not file_path.startswith(os.path.abspath(LOG_DIR)):
            abort(403)
        if not os.path.exists(file_path):
            abort(404)
        return send_from_directory(...)
    except Exception as e:
        abort(400)

`abort()` raises `werkzeug.exceptions.HTTPException`, which the blanket
`except Exception` catches — so both the 403 and the 404 come back as 400,
collapsing exactly the distinction the two checks above exist to make. A
missing log is reported as a malformed request.

The cover-enforcer copy was fixed on the #1408 branch by re-raising
`HTTPException` ahead of the broad handler. The other two still have it. The fix
is the same three lines in each.

Low impact — a wrong status code on a log download, not a data or access defect.
title: download_current_log siblings rewrite their own abort(403)/abort(404) as 400
